findings.body: INCOMPLETE_ACCOUNT_ROUTE and the existing PENDING_ROUTE have the same effect in the guard: either lets a pending caller reach the handler. The join endpoint can use PENDING_ROUTE and still return its specific ACCOUNT_INCOMPLETE refusal. Remove the new flag and its guard branch.
findings.title: Simpler: reuse the pending-route flag → remove the duplicate incomplete-account flag

findings.body: The new service-bus request checks only whether a member exists, then the transaction repeats that check against the Member row. The code states that this row exists only after onboarding. The transaction check supplies the required join-time decision; remove the redundant request before it.
findings.title: Simpler: remove the pre-transaction account lookup → use the locked Member check

findings.body: This new Forge task-status file is outside the permitted paths and supplies no code, API contract, or test needed for the invite work. Omit it from this branch.
findings.title: Remove the task-status file outside this part's scope
